sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United, sitting top with 34 points from 16 games, host Shawbury United on Saturday 21 November at 15:00. Sandbach come into this fixture in excellent form, having won their most recent league match and showing three wins in their last five league outings. Shawbury visit having picked up a win in their last league game but remain in the bottom half of the table.
divisionWide: Tuesday evening sees two key fixtures: New Mills travel to Crewe, with the visitors seeking to bounce back from recent losses, while Shawbury United visit Shawbury in an earlier fixture on the same night. Second-placed Wolverhampton Casuals, joint on 34 points with Sandbach but with a game in hand, will be looking to maintain their perfect recent form of six consecutive league wins when they play their next fixture. AFC Bridgnorth host Wednesfield Community on Saturday after back-to-back wins, while also featuring in the Tuesday night match away at Shawbury. Alsager Town, sitting near the foot of the table with 11 points, face New Mills at home on Saturday before a midweek trip to Barnton on Tuesday. In-form Allscott Heath (eight wins in their last six league games) and Barnton (four consecutive wins in the league) are among the division's strongest performers. Crewe face Cheadle Heath Nomads on Saturday following a loss. Foley Meir host Dawley Town on Saturday in a battle of mid-table sides, while Market Drayton Town welcome Stafford Town—a clash between teams separated by just two points. Widnes Town entertain Brereton Social, with Widnes struggling with just one win in 14 games. Sandbach's title rivals will be watching closely as the race for top spot intensifies.
